source_refs.note: Homogeneity of Physical Equations: a main subheading of 1.7 Dimensions of physical quantities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 15-15.

blocks.text: Correctness of an equation can be checked by showing that the dimensions of quantities on both sides of the equation are the same. This is known as principle of homogeneity.
